methodology.demand: Job postings now vs their peak (Indeed Hiring Lab US posting index per job category, peak since Feb 2020). Where a source has no peak, change vs about 90 days earlier. Occupation change is the mean across sources; every figure links to its source.
methodology.risk: Published Anthropic observed exposure for exact SOC6 .00 occupations; otherwise matched O*NET task penetration mean (50% coverage required). Optional normalized task imports use automation + half augmentation. Not replacement probability or evidence of causation.
methodology.sentiment: English keyword lexicon with local negation, bounded non-representative samples. No social text or identities exported. Does not change demand or risk.
methodology.capability: Published AI benchmark scores on the work this job does (for example AI coding agents on real software-engineering tasks). Shows what AI can do, not what it is used for; never mixed into demand or risk.
methodology.social: Weekly manual read of recent X/LinkedIn posts per occupation. Each post is counted as a job ad, decline (job shrinking or replaced), growth (job safe or growing) or neither. Score = (growth - decline) / (growth + decline) x 100, null below 3 opinion posts. Small, non-representative samples; shown separately and never mixed into demand or risk.
methodology.news: Lab feed entries, model popularity and research papers are context, not verified release events or causes of hiring changes.
